sloka: कच्चिन्नागवनं गुप्तं कच्चित्ते सन्ति धेनुका: ।कच्चिन्न गणिकाश्वानां कुञ्जराणां च तृप्यसि ॥ २.१००.५१॥
transliteration: kaccinnāgavanaṁ guptaṁ kaccitte santi dhenukā: ।kaccinna gaṇikāśvānāṁ kuñjarāṇāṁ ca tṛpyasi ॥ 2.100.51॥

translations.english: O prince, I trust, you rise early daily and present yourself welladomed to the people on the thoroughfare.
